temperature_suffix_basis: 用户2026-10-11指定的订购型号I；Vivado目录无单独I条目，此查询不证明实物温度/速度等级。
command: puts [version -short]; puts [get_parts -quiet xc7z020clg400-2]; puts [get_parts -quiet xc7z020clg400-2I]; puts [get_parts -quiet XC7Z020-2CLG400I]; foreach p [get_parts -quiet xc7z020clg400-2] {puts [list NAME [get_property NAME $p] FAMILY [get_property FAMILY $p] DEVICE [get_property DEVICE $p] PACKAGE [get_property PACKAGE $p] SPEED [get_property SPEED $p]]}; puts [get_parts -quiet xc7z020*clg400*-2*]
